task: Add safe fresh-PASS reuse to ordinary validation so unchanged validation work is not executed twice.
outcome: After a complete PASS, running lattice validate again on the same clean material and identical validation identity prints a fast auditable result such as validation PASS (reused fresh evidence) with zero validation commands executed. If code, story-owned files, command specs, config, entrypoint digest, focus/full/profile, verification policy, coverage completeness, tree cleanliness, trusted lineage, or HEAD stability changes, the terminal instead reports the precise reuse refusal reason and executes the real validation plan.
facts: B-c163 had five successful reruns on identical materialHash and storyFilesHash, wasting 1,926,151ms (32.10 minutes).
B-19ca executed 45/45 commands successfully, failed only on stale verificationEvidence, then re-executed the identical 45 commands for 370 seconds after refresh.
Ordinary verifier currently has no fresh-PASS reuse gate.
DONE reuse already implements exact-head and trusted-story-metadata-descendant lineage in done-prepare-validation-reuse.ts.
Current ordinary TestEvidenceData lacks a complete command/policy/focus identity, so three tree hashes alone are insufficient.
constraints: Any uncertainty or mismatch falls back to execution, never PASS.
Reuse decision runs inside withValidationExecutionLock and rechecks HEAD to prevent TOCTOU.
Reused validation must not rewrite test evidence or create a metadata commit.
Legacy evidence without the new identity executes.
DONE-specific command-spec envelope and build-proof semantics remain DONE-only.
Configured commands, fallback discovery, and validate-file sources must all be covered.
